key_insight: HOMIE improves human-object centric video personalization by better preserving the target subject while also modeling how that subject should interact with different objects, including abstract ones like logos. It combines multiple reference signals to make personalized video generation more faithful and more interaction-aware.
problem_solved: The paper addresses human-object centric video personalization, where current methods often fail to balance subject identity fidelity with realistic human-object interactions, especially when the object is abstract or hard to ground. It also targets the limitation of relying on weak or incomplete reference cues for personalization.
method: Uses multimodal reference information to enrich personalization beyond a single subject image or clip.
Introduces a human-object centric framework that explicitly models both subject appearance and interaction patterns.
Enhances video generation with intelligent refinement so the personalized subject remains consistent across frames while interacting plausibly with diverse objects.
impact: This matters for practitioners building controllable video generation systems, virtual avatars, ads, or product-centric content, where both identity preservation and interaction realism are critical. It offers a pathway to more reliable subject-driven video synthesis in complex, multi-object scenarios.
